title: Panel view on PCB documents listing selected primitives
summary: Attaches a per-document panel view to a PCB with IServerDocument.AddView, lists the selected primitives on selection-change view notifications, and registers the SDK's DXP.NotificationHandler for document activation.
phrasings: list selected objects on a board
react to selection changes in the PCB editor
add a panel view to a document
register a notification handler in C#

commands.name: ShowSelection
commands.description: List the selected primitives of the focused PCB, as text

commands.name: AttachView
commands.description: Add the per-document panel view to the focused PCB document

commands.name: Listen
commands.description: Register or unregister the notification handler (DXP.NotificationHandler), or report what it received

commands.name: SelectTest
commands.description: Test setup: select the first Count primitives of a kind through IPCB_Primitive.Selected, or deselect all
commands.params: Kind=<TObjectId name, default Pad>|Count=<n, default 3>, or Clear=true

commands.name: Notification.View
commands.description: Called by the shim for view notification codes 3 (selection changed) and 42 (update views): logs the selected primitives

commands.name: Notification.Document
commands.description: Called by the shim on DocumentActivating: with AutoAttach on, attaches the panel view to the activated PCB document
